business_model.basis: stated in the cited item [P1]
business_model.claim: Climate transition policies and severe weather shift commodity revenue drivers, shrinking legacy energy markets such as fuel oil while creating volatility and market-share opportunities in renewables and weather-sensitive agricultural products.
